sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor's meets the degree/field route, subject to completion and academic review.
University normally requires GPA3.0; Math publishes no additional GPA cutoff. Expected preparation:
proof-based linear algebra, modern algebra and two semesters of analysis; missing second analysis must be
made up. International/F-1 applicants eligible for on-campus PhD. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD; prepare unofficial transcripts, ≤2-page personal/academic goals statement, CV and
three referees. Email graduate_applications@ncsu.edu for UChicago-study English waiver review. No
supervisor consent/interview required publicly. After academic acceptance, complete Visa Clearance Form and
Certificate of Financial Responsibility; VCF becomes accessible only then. Admission acceptance precedes I-20
creation. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application adviser agreement or interview required. Focus AG interest on Esser/Cid Ruiz;
representation/quantum algebra has a wider faculty cluster. No dedicated arithmetic-geometry/number-theory
group established in the research-group roster. Adjacent algebraic-statistics option Sullivant is labeled
separately; pure differential/topological faculty not indiscriminately listed. [s1] [s6] [s19] [s20]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use central Graduate School online application. Save all essays/CV/transcripts carefully: latestNovember3 help
prohibits ordinary revisions after submission, with exceptional significant changes referred to department.
Recommender-list corrections are a documented exception. Supporting documents electronic, not mailed;
official verification records follow recommendation. [s1] [s3] [s9] [s18]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Admissions explicitly updated for Fall 2027 with Dec 15, 2026/Mar 1, 2027 deadlines. Stipend is July 2026
benchmark;2027 offer amount unconfirmed. New Fall 2027 curriculum changes to four breadth groups,
including modeling/computation, even for pureMath PhD. [s1] [s11] [s39]

sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Without waiver: newTOEFL total4 and every section≥4; speaking≥5 forTA. LegacyTOEFL total80,each≥18;
speaking23 for interactiveTA or26 for lecturing/labTA. IELTS Academic6.5 every band, speaking7 forTA;
DET110 with listed literacy/comprehension/conversation/production≥110, conversation/production125 forTA.

UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
At least one completed year full-time in a degree program at a regionally accredited four-year US institution,
cumulativeGPA≥3.0, permits admission waiver. Thus a completed UChicago BA normally qualifies if GPA
condition met; graduation is not necessary to meet the one-year rule. Email graduate_applications@ncsu.edu
for transcript evaluation. Confirm whether any separate TA oral assessment is required; admissions waiver is
not explicitly a blanket exemption fromTA standards. [s7] [s8] [s40]

recommendation list. Treat saving/adding that entry as sending an invitation; obtain writer agreement first. [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
July 2026 Math guide: USD22,125 per academic year for standard50%TA(20h/week), not an explicit Fall 2027
amount. PhD offers include stipend, tuition and student health insurance; student fees remain payable.
SummerTA may exist but is not guaranteed. RA pay generally≥TA. Generic fellowship range22000-34000
yearly is not an individual offer. [s1] [s11] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Current admissions page guarantees five years with satisfactory progress. Guide specifies five years from
bachelor's, four with an incoming relevantMS; sixth-yearTA only conditional and usually77% of standard rate.
Tuition support lasts10semesters fromBA(8fromMS). Limited-termTA exceptions exist; read the actual offer. [s1]
[s11] [s12]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International PhD applicants eligible for departmentalTA/RA and university fellowships generally. F-1 students
ineligible for state residency retain total tuition coverage while GSSP-eligible; do not apply US/PR second-year
residency rules to John. Named external awards can impose citizenship limits. [s1] [s8] [s11] [s14]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Renewal needs satisfactory academic progress and assistantship performance; fulltime enrollment/GSSP
eligibility required. From Fall 2026, first-yearTA seminar is mandatory for future recitation/instructor roles,

irrespective of prior teaching. Student health premium covered; dependents self-paid. Fall+springTA normally
covers subsequent summer health; mixedRA arrangements need confirmation. Student fees are excluded. [s1]
[s11] [s12] [s13]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate funding application for departmental consideration. Goodnight/University Graduate and other
named awards require department/college nominations, not direct student submissions.2027 internal calls and
extra documents must be obtained from mathgradprograms@ncsu.edu. [s1] [s14] [s15]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Luh award specifically supports admitted students interested in algebra, selected by graduate
director/admissions committee; amount not public. RA grants, summerTA, research internships, travel support
and eventual dissertation-completion grants are alternatives. Goodnight doctoral award is by nomination;
current amount/2027 criteria not public on its general page. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s15] [s16]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD95 for international/nonresident-alien applicants, nonrefundable. USD85 domestic/USPR does not apply
merely because John attends UChicago. [s2] [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math explicitly says application-fee waivers are unavailable to international students (andMS applicants).
Limited exceptional-hardshipPhD waivers are for US citizens/permanent residents; F-1 does not qualify. [s1]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor's meets the degree/field route, subject to completion and academic review.
University normally requires GPA3.0; Math publishes no additional GPA cutoff. Expected preparation:
proof-based linear algebra, modern algebra and two semesters of analysis; missing second analysis must be
made up. International/F-1 applicants eligible for on-campus PhD. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD; prepare unofficial transcripts, ≤2-page personal/academic goals statement, CV and
three referees. Email graduate_applications@ncsu.edu for UChicago-study English waiver review. No
supervisor consent/interview required publicly. After academic acceptance, complete Visa Clearance Form and
Certificate of Financial Responsibility; VCF becomes accessible only then. Admission acceptance precedes I-20
creation. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-application adviser agreement or interview required. Focus AG interest on Esser/Cid Ruiz;
representation/quantum algebra has a wider faculty cluster. No dedicated arithmetic-geometry/number-theory
group established in the research-group roster. Adjacent algebraic-statistics option Sullivant is labeled
separately; pure differential/topological faculty not indiscriminately listed. [s1] [s6] [s19] [s20]

Use central Graduate School online application. Save all essays/CV/transcripts carefully: latestNovember3 help
prohibits ordinary revisions after submission, with exceptional significant changes referred to department.

official verification records follow recommendation. [s1] [s3] [s9] [s18]

benchmark;2027 offer amount unconfirmed. New Fall 2027 curriculum changes to four breadth groups,

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago mathematics bachelor's meets the degree/field route, subject to completion and academic review.
University normally requires GPA3.0; Math publishes no additional GPA cutoff. Expected preparation:
proof-based linear algebra, modern algebra and two semesters of analysis; missing second analysis must be
made up. International/F-1 applicants eligible for on-campus PhD. [s1] [s6] [s8]

Choose Mathematics PhD; prepare unofficial transcripts, ≤2-page personal/academic goals statement, CV and
three referees. Email graduate_applications@ncsu.edu for UChicago-study English waiver review. No
supervisor consent/interview required publicly. After academic acceptance, complete Visa Clearance Form and
Certificate of Financial Responsibility; VCF becomes accessible only then. Admission acceptance precedes I-20
creation. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s8]

representation/quantum algebra has a wider faculty cluster. No dedicated arithmetic-geometry/number-theory
group established in the research-group roster. Adjacent algebraic-statistics option Sullivant is labeled
separately; pure differential/topological faculty not indiscriminately listed. [s1] [s6] [s19] [s20]

Use central Graduate School online application. Save all essays/CV/transcripts carefully: latestNovember3 help
prohibits ordinary revisions after submission, with exceptional significant changes referred to department.

official verification records follow recommendation. [s1] [s3] [s9] [s18]

benchmark;2027 offer amount unconfirmed. New Fall 2027 curriculum changes to four breadth groups,

supporting documents due by midnight Eastern Standard Time on the applicable deadline. John is international
even while studying in Chicago; do not use domestic June dates. [s1] [s2]

December 15, 2026 for first funded offers and recruitment-weekend consideration; March 1, 2027 final funded
